name: @kayzen-flux/desktop
description: KAYZEN Flux — téléchargeur et convertisseur multimédia local, sans publicité

scripts.dist:linux: pnpm build && node scripts/fetch-sidecars.mjs linux-x64 && electron-builder --linux --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:win: pnpm build && node scripts/fetch-sidecars.mjs win-x64 && electron-builder --win --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: pnpm build && node scripts/fetch-sidecars.mjs mac-arm64 && node scripts/fetch-sidecars.mjs mac-x64 && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --x64 --publish never
